subject: TOURN: podium streams ALL teams live with no limit, and its freeze is cosmetic
description: tournament-podium.html:354 subscribes to orderBy(score desc) with no .limit(), live, so every score change re-sends every team to every viewer. Separately the freeze only prepends a warning div while the listener keeps updating - broadcast.html:307-321 already implements a REAL hard freeze that snapshots standings; the podium never got it. The projector page is the one that leaks the surprise. Fix: port the broadcast freeze and add a limit.
